content: Introduction to Complex Formulas, Key Advanced Functions
Logical Functions: IF, AND, OR, IFERROR, and nested IF
statements., Lookup Functions: VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, INDEX
MATCH, and XLOOKUP., Text Functions: CONCATENATE
TEXT, LEFT, RIGHT, MID, and TRIM., Date and Time Functions:
TODAY, NOW, YEAR, MONTH, DAY, and DATEDIF
Mathematical and Statistical Functions SUMIFS, COUNTIFS
AVERAGEIFS. SUMPRODUCT, RANK, LARGE, SMALL
MEDIAN., Array Formulas
Data Sorting and Filtering, Pivot Tables and Pivot Charts , Chart
Customization, Dashboard Creation , Data Validation: Setting up
custom validation rules, input restrictions, and error messages for
data consistency., Conditional Formatting
Introduction to Macros, Recording and Running Macros
Introduction to VBA (Visual Basic for Applications), Debugging
and Error Handling
What-If Analysis Using Goal Seek, Scenario Manager, and Data
Tables for forecasting and simulations, Sensitivity analysis for
decision-making., Data Consolidation, Power Query and Power
Pivot, Excel Security and Protection
